blocks.text: Mid Meadows homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Mid Meadows, September 2026. Detached houses: 9 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 11%. Condos and townhomes: 12 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 33% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 7 over 4 months against an average of 8.8 listed, about 5.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold. condos and townhomes sold 15 over 4 months against an average of 14.0 listed, about 3.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 5 sold.
